activation.when_unavailable: Stop live XCE lookup; use the authorized read-only backup recovery below when available. Ask the user to select or @mention XCE to restore the live connection.

triggers: Use a saved character, creature, prop, vehicle, location, scene, storyboard or reference by name
Retrieve, inspect, continue, edit or regenerate a saved XCE asset

lookup.name_lookup: Resolve the named project if supplied, inspect its manifest, disambiguate stored names and use returned IDs. Do not infer from franchise canon.
lookup.code_normalization: Trim outer whitespace and normalize case; preserve internal separators and identifiers.
lookup.multiple_codes: Resolve each supplied code separately. Do not render the combined job until every required reference is retrieved and checked.

require: Actual image content blocks for visual work
verification.visual_inputs: Inspect and pass the actual returned images into the image tool. Text, metadata, filenames and URLs do not prove image-conditioned generation.
verification.drafts: Allow explicit draft retrieval; do not auto-approve.
verification.scene: Preserve the uploaded storyboard as a composition reference. Do not invent shots or import character identity from it.
verification.diagnostic: Failed or DIAGNOSTIC images may be inspected for diagnosis only; never use them as generation identity inputs.

on_failure.not_found: Stop and identify the missing code; no similar-name replacement.
on_failure.ambiguous: Stop and ask which stored record is intended.
on_failure.project_mismatch: Stop and report the owning project; do not silently switch.
on_failure.folder_locked: Stop and ask the user to unlock the project in Xstudio. Never request a PIN in chat.
on_failure.missing_or_unsupported_image: Report that visual retrieval failed; never claim visual inspection or substitute an online image.
on_failure.host_image_transfer_unavailable: Stop the image-dependent task and explain that the actual retrieved image cannot be supplied to the renderer.

intent.lookup_only: Retrieve and report the resolved asset; do not generate, mutate, save, lock, move or delete.
intent.authorized_production: After retrieval and actual image inspection, honor the requested operation, source roles, preflight and free/included generation rules.
intent.retry: Fetch original saved sources again; never use the rejected output as identity.

post_generation.destination: Explicit user destination; otherwise xce-lost-assets under standing save authorization.
post_generation.method: register_reference with actual final bytes when supported; verify with inspect_project_manifest.
post_generation.originals: Keep separate; never overwrite or auto-lock.
post_generation.uncertain_save: Inspect before retrying; report partial saves honestly.
post_generation.unavailable_bytes: Deliver the successful image and report studio saving incomplete; never fabricate a save.
post_generation.idempotency: Pass a stable idempotency_key for the exact output, using its host output ID or a SHA-256-derived key. Reuse it only for identical bytes. register_reference verifies stored bytes, returns reused=true for completed retries and refuses recreation of intentionally deleted outputs.
post_generation.active_project: Saving to Lost Assets must preserve the active creative project.

never_claim: Every regular chat will invoke XCE automatically
JSON alone changes host app availability
Passing code checks proves visual likeness

recovery.secondary: Connected ChatGPT file tools, under /XSTUDIO/<exact project name>/Site Backup
recovery.native_chatgpt_project: No automatic access is assumed. A native ChatGPT Project and the XSTUDIO file folder are different destinations.
when_allowed: Diagnostic investigation of a code not found in the live site
search_steps: Search exact supplied asset code with the connected file tools, then the exact project name and saved project-records filename.
Read the matched backup JSON; do not rely on snippets or similar filenames.
Verify exact asset_code, project_id, project name, backup timestamp and snapshot revision. Disambiguate multiple projects or versions.
Locate actual linked image files in that project folder using retained file identities and hashes when available. A records JSON without image files cannot provide visual inputs.
Report backup provenance and age. Reconcile with the live site when available before production or any write.
recovery.missing_media: Stop visual work and report the missing actual image; metadata is not a reference image.
recovery.authorization_during_outage: A records backup cannot prove current lock/deletion/access status. Use it only for diagnostic read-only inspection when authorization is uncertain; stop production, restoration and writes until live access/state is confirmed.

lock.trigger: Explicit LOCK for the exact reviewed edited image
lock.site: lock_asset_anchor verifies the recorded visual review and source image ID, then approves that exact version.
lock.code: The asset code retrieves only that locked source image, never a newer unapproved edit or all historical inputs.
lock.other_versions: Retain files; discard sibling draft versions from production. No automatic deletion.
lock.second_destination: Save actual locked image bytes and the verified asset/project/code record under /XSTUDIO/<project name>/Site Backup using connected file tools.
lock.completion: Report site lock and folder save separately. Pending or failed folder save is not a successful dual-destination completion.
lock.native_project: Do not claim that a file-folder save attaches the file to a native ChatGPT Project.
